crossRefs.note: Now there are various kinds of gifts, but the same Spirit.
Follow after love and earnestly desire spiritual gifts, but especially that you may prophesy.
If any man thinks himself to be a prophet, or spiritual, let him recognize the things which I write to you, that they…
He gave some to be apostles; and some, prophets; and some, evangelists; and some, shepherds and teachers;
Now I would not have you ignorant, brothers, that our fathers were all under the cloud, and all passed through the sea;
For we don’t desire to have you uninformed, brothers, concerning our affliction which happened to us in Asia, that we…
But we don’t want you to be ignorant, brothers, concerning those who have fallen asleep, so that you don’t grieve like…
But don’t forget this one thing, beloved, that one day is with the Lord as a thousand years, and a thousand years as…

translations.web: Now concerning spiritual things, brothers, I don’t want you to be ignorant.
translations.bsb: Now about spiritual gifts, brothers, I do not want you to be uninformed.
translations.kjv: Now concerning spiritual gifts, brethren, I would ➔ not have you ignorant.
translations.asv: Now concerning spiritual gifts, brethren, I would not have you ignorant.
